entities.summary: Jhonatan Solano is a Colombian former professional baseball catcher who is the manager of the Tigres de Cartagena of the Colombian Winter League. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Washington Nationals and Miami Marlins, making his MLB debut in 2012.
